newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb on devaluation.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb on devaluation.

text.p: The Pakistan rupee ended 0.10 down at 41.10 to the dollar on Wednesday after being being adjusted downward by the State (central) Bank of Pakistan (SBP), dealers said.
"The rupee slipped on its devaluation against the dollar," dealer Owais Kalia said. "It will slide further tomorrow as people expect another devaluation in the short term."
The SBP adjusted the rupee down to 40.2400/40.4412 to the dollar from 40.1200/40.3206 fixed on October 22.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates ended steady at 2.35 percent. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
